quote:
The AI assistant that actually does the work — I've tried a lot of "AI assistants," but Town is the first one that genuinely runs my day instead of just chatting about it. The routines are the killer feature - I have it triaging my inbox, prepping morning briefings, monitoring filings, and surfacing what actually matters, all on autopilot. It connects to email, calendar, and drive seamlessly and just gets things done in the background.

What sets it apart is the depth. It remembers my preferences, learns how I work, and tailors everything to my role and priorities over time. The ability to build custom routines that trigger on schedules, emails, or calendar events means I've automated workflows I never thought an assistant could handle. It's like having a capable chief of staff who's available 24/7.

Setup was straightforward, the responses are sharp and concise, and it keeps me in control with approvals where it counts. If you want an assistant that takes real work off your plate rather than adding another app to babysit, Town is it. Highly recommended.
author: djschulzmeister
